game.name: Club, The (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
game.desc: The Club on Xbox 360 is a shooter with a very simple principle: kill as many enemies as possible in order to satisfy the rich people who sent you to the slaughterhouse. Here you are in the middle of arenas filled with guys determined to stop you from advancing. Chain together deaths to boost your score before you can proudly display it online. A multiplayer mode also allows you to compete with friends online.
